safe_input_gate: No scientific Adult fit until S2 admits role-only exports with exact allowed labels/rows and a scientific loader that never reads excluded arrays. S2's one isolated custodian exporter may transiently deserialize mixed storage mechanically under the continuation exception without inspecting or emitting excluded values.
fit_admission_seal: Outer fit requires S2 source, feature export, seed-specific reference export and admission manifest SHA256; exact OSF_DEFENSE_FIT role; S2 row count, group count, sorted row-ID, unique group-ID and ordered row/group-pair SHA256; full FitData SHA256; ordered fit row/group SHA256; ordered 83-column schema SHA256; and Ucal_1/Ucal_2 teacher IDs. Exact comparisons occur before creating mode-0700 private attempt files.
control_eligibility_anchor: FEATURE_REF_RAW83_U fixed by S1 for all feature-track controls; B-TASK and B-RAW-TASK are separately eligible competitors, not anchors
attack_split: ATTACK_FIT_NEW groups deterministically partitioned by S2 into attack_fit and attack_tune, disjoint by group. Exact membership hashes required in effective lock.
attack_selection: Fit four fixed model configurations per view on attack_fit, freeze validation-selected reader and orientation on attack_tune. Predeclare P(SEX=1) and 1−P(SEX=1) as score readers; primary INNER AUC is fixed-slate max. Report every reader and tune-selected winner. Pair slate includes all local score-reader aliases only with identity receipts.
same_role_selection_warning: Scientific candidate/control selection on INNER_SELECTION remains exploratory, but attack reader/hyperparameter/orientation selection must finish on disjoint ATTACK_FIT_NEW tune groups.
bootstrap_envelope_rule: For each paired group resample, recompute each fixed reader AUC, take max per arm/view/seed, then average paired seed endpoints. An interval for only the realized winning reader is not an interval for the max envelope.
encoder_optimizer_updates_per_encoder: T=600 proposed in TRAINING_DESIGN.md; S3 smoke and S1 prefit seal required before this becomes effective
critic_update_schedule: JVIB/DVIB/RAWJ: each local T and pair 2T. SEQ12/SEQ21: first local T, second local T, second-stage pair 2T. LOCAL: each local 2T. TASK and RAW-TASK: none. Total 24T across eight arms per seed.
local_privacy_coefficient_schedule: JVIB/DVIB/RAWJ use 0.05 × mean(local CE1,local CE2), giving 0.025 per view. LOCAL and SEQ single-purpose stages use 0.025 × their active local CE. Pair coefficient is 0.05 where active.
sequential_dependency: Each stage2 binds stage1 checkpoint, fixed one-draw defense-fit release, ordered defense-fit row and group IDs, feature schema and sampler plan SHA256; these are recomputed before stage2. LOCAL stage1 is not an alias because its local critic receives 2T versus SEQ stage1 T updates.
not_yet_counted_pending_shared_contract: S1's FEATURE_REF_RAW83_U anchor fit/calibration/attack units are shared feature-track baseline units, outside these eight B arms; S3 must charge them before a B competitive comparison.
Shared source teacher/cache admission or regeneration; count only on exact immutable identity.
Shared 83-column preprocessing fit and any attacker preprocessing fits inside the model-fit records.
Noise-off B-JVIB diagnostic: if reported, add one forward and four attacker fits per view per seed, plus calibration if its probability differs.
Any expanded full attacker slate or repeated-query attack; amend counts before CAMPAIGN_LOCK.
Synthetic correctness and exact tiny-law oracles; S3 must time and charge their CPU cost.
arithmetic: Eight release arms (two prototypes plus six controls) × three views × four fresh model configurations = 96 attack fits/seed. Each model contributes both fixed output orientations, giving 192 fresh score readers/seed; each of two local views contributes eight additional zero-fit ignore-recipient score aliases to the pair bank, giving 128 aliases/seed across eight arms. Eight arms × two tasks = 16 calibration scalars/seed; eight arms × three allowed evaluation roles = 24 paired forward passes/seed, plus two frozen first-stage defense-fit forwards. The portfolio registry's 16 candidate-by-seed slots refers to eight prototypes across four families at two seeds; Team B's 16 *arm-by-seed* screen cells include controls and are a different count. These are proposed exact units for this fixed design, subject to S1/S2 pre-lock revision after smoke timing; no real unit has run.
